translations.web: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.
translations.bsb: Pay attention to him and listen to his voice; do not defy him, for he will not forgive rebellion, since My Name is in him.
translations.kjv: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
translations.asv: Take ye heed before him, and hearken unto his voice; provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgression: for my name is in him.
